summary: Explains task execution: each task runs on all matched hosts before the next (changeable with strategies), failed hosts are removed for the rest of the playbook, and output includes per-task status and a final recap.
questions: Does Ansible run each task on all hosts before moving on?
What happens to a host after a task fails on it?
What does the play recap show?

answer_card.title: How tasks execute
answer_card.answer_md: By default each task runs on all matched hosts, one task at a time, before moving to the next (strategies can change this). If a task fails on a host, that host is **removed from the rest of the playbook**. Output shows each task's result per host and a final summary that counts failures and unreachable hosts separately.
